values.note: Amortization of definite-lived intangibles, stated in prose rather than as a statement line. Read alongside 'Depreciation and capital lease amortization expense for 2016, 2015, and 2014 was $2,280 million, $2,191 million, and $2,108 million': 2,280 + 18 = 2,298, which is exactly the 'Depreciation and amortization' line on the Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows. That arithmetic is the evidence that the cash-flow D&A line INCLUDES intangible amortization, which is what makes subtracting one from the other yield depreciation.

values.scale: stated inline in the note text
values.caption: During 2015, we announced our decision to wind down certain noncore operations. As a result, we recorded a $35 million pretax impairment loss, which included approximately $23 million of intangible assets and $12 million of goodwill.
values.statement: Notes to Consolidated Financial Statements — Goodwill and Intangible Assets
values.note: THE COMBINED-CAPTION CASE, and the reason this figure is here. Target reports one impairment covering goodwill AND intangibles; the goodwill component alone is $12 million. The concept map resolves the combined $35 million with a caution saying the figure is at or above the goodwill charge alone. This filing is the evidence for that caution: 35 is indeed above 12, so a test against it reads more harshly than intended and never more leniently. A reader wanting the goodwill component alone will not get it from any tagged fact in this filing.

values.scale: stated inline in the note text
values.caption: No impairments were recorded in 2016 or 2014 as a result of the annual goodwill impairment tests performed.
values.statement: Notes to Consolidated Financial Statements — Goodwill and Intangible Assets
values.note: A STATED nil, not an absent one. The filer says in words that nothing was written off, and separately tags the zero. That is the distinction the measure that consumes this depends on: a year with a stated zero counts as a year with no write-off, and a year with no figure at all is absent rather than nil.
